# Feature request

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is, e.g.
*"I'm always frustrated when ..."*

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Privacy / ethics check

If your feature involves face recognition on real individuals, confirm:

- [ ] It only operates on public, indexed web results.
- [ ] It does NOT bypass private accounts, login gates, or captchas.
- [ ] It does NOT store raw biometric data without consent.

## Additional context

Screenshots, links, references, anything else helpful.
